# OpenSocrates 1.1.1

OpenSocrates 1.1.1 makes the Claude and Codex integrations behave like one
managed product.

## Highlights

- Install, inspect, update, or remove every ready host with `--host all`.
  Cross-host updates preflight and stage both packages before activation and
  restore every changed host if any activation fails.
- Claude now presents one `/opensocrates` entry. The 48 authored methods,
  rigor, evidence audit, trace, and status controls remain available to the
  controller as internal references instead of cluttering the user interface.
- Opt in to automatic reconciliation on Apple-silicon macOS with
  `auto-update enable --host all`. The LaunchAgent uses interval jitter, a
  single-instance lock, checksum verification, atomic staging, rollback, and a
  major-version block by default.
- `status --host all` shows desired and available versions, recent updater
  times, and per-host drift from one desired-state manifest.

## Upgrade notes

Updating a managed v1.1.0 Claude installation replaces the complete managed
package tree, so stale method skills and helper commands are removed. Existing
`--host claude` and `--host codex` commands remain supported.

Automatic updates are disabled until explicitly enabled. The updater stores no
prompts, transcripts, credentials, or workspace paths; its private receipt is
limited to version, time, host result, and error category.
